newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy opportunity seen in tobacco cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy opportunity seen in tobacco cos.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw said it viewed yesterday's pullback in tobacco stocks as an overreaction to litigation events and recommended using the weakness as a buying oppportunity.
-- reiterated buy ratings on Philip Morris Cos Inc, RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp and UST Inc.
-- said Mississippi court ruling on Medicaid suit "has nothing to do with the merits of the suit."
-- said RJR Nabisco memo to be introduced as evidence in Florida trial "is nothing new and has been used before."
-- Philip Morris was up two to 128, RJR Nabisco rose 5/8 to 33-7/8 and UST was up 1/8 to 32-7/8.
